results.title: Ko Kwankwaso zai raba ƙuri'ar Atiku a jihohin arewa?
results.content: A zaɓen 2023, Atiku Abubakar na PDP da Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso na NNPP sun yi gogayya wajen neman goyon bayan masu kaɗa ƙuri'a a jihohin Arewa.

results.title: Howe na shirin tattauna da United, ƙungiyoyin Firimiya uku na zawarcin Karl
results.content: A shirye Eddie Howe yake don fara tattaunawa da Manchester United idan har suka raba gari da Michael Carrick, wasu ƙunguiyoyin dake buga gasar Firimiya uku na sa ido kan ɗan wasan Bayern Munich Lennart Karl, sai Manchester United da ke harin ɗan wasan Everton Jarrad Branthwaite.

results.title: Shin Iran na son yaƙi ya zama hanyar karya lagon Trump a zaɓe ne?
results.content: Yaƙin da Isra'ila da Amurka suka ƙaddamar kan Iran ya haifar da hauhawar farashin makamashi a kasuwannin duniya, kuma babu wata alama ta kawo ƙarshen shi nan kusa.

results.title: Iran da ƙawayenta na shirin kai mana hari lokacin zaɓe - Netanyahu

results.title: Gine-gine 8 mafiya ƙayatarwa a duniya
results.content: Tsawon lokaci mai yawa, masu zanen gine-gine suna amfani da launi a matsayin wata muhimmiyar hanya wajen ƙara wa ayyukansu kyan gani, armashi da kuma baje fasaha

results.title: Da gaske Tinubu ne ya yi silar zaman Buhari shugaban Najeriya?
results.content: Sau biyar marigayin ya tsaya takarar shugaban ƙasa, inda ya faɗi uku a 2003 da 2007 da 2011, sannan ya samu nasara a biyu a 2015 da 2019.

results.title: Amfani da illolin madarar shanun da ba a tafasa ba
results.content: Yawancin nau'ikan madarar da ake sayarwa a kasuwa ana dumama ta ne domin kashe kwayoyin cutar da ke cikinta da kuma hana ta lalacewa da wuri.

results.title: Ibrahim Traoré: Me ya sa Burkina Faso ta haramta amfani da kalmomin "matalauciyar ƙasa" da "ƙaramar ƙasa"?
results.content: Burkina Faso ilitangaza marekebisho ya mitaala, ikiwemo masomo ya Historia, Jiografia na Elimu ya Uraia, kwa lengo la kuondoa, kwa mujibu wake, misemo na maudhui yanayoonekana kuwa "hayana mantiki" au yasiyolingana na uhalisia wa taifa la Burkina Faso.

results.title: Sauke manhaja
results.content: Mahnajar BBC World News za ta ba ku damar samun labaran duniya da na cikin gida da ɗumi-ɗumi.

results.title: Takarar Ballon d'Or: Fafatawa ta yi zafi a neman kyautar ƙwallon ƙafa mafi girma
results.content: Kyautar Ballon d'Or ita ce mafi girma ga dan wasan kwallon kafa a duniya - kuma kishirwar lashe gasar bana sai kara zafi take, fiye da wadanda aka yi a baya.

results.title: Man United ta kara nutsewa a teburin Premier
results.content: Wannan shafi ne da ke kawo muku labaran wasannin kai tsaye a BBC Hausa daga 19 zuwa 25 ga watan Oktoban 2026.

results.title: Liverpool na harin Luka Vuskovic, AC Milan na son Leny Yoro
results.content: Manyan ƙungiyoyin na ci gaba da sa ido kan ɗan wasan Brighton Luka Vuskovic, sai dai Liverpool ba ta da niyar ɗauko ɗan wasan Trent Alexander-Arnold zuwa ƙungiyar, iyayin da kuma AC Milan ke harin ɗan wasan Manchester United Leny Yoro.

results.title: Manchester United na harin Howe, Arsenal na zawarcin Baena
results.content: Ana alaƙanta Manchester United da Antonio Conte, ko Unai Emery, ko Eddie Howe, ko Julian Nagelsmann a cikin jerin waɗan da za su iya maye gurbin Michael Carrick, yayin da Arsenal ke son ɗan wasan Atletico Madrid Alex Baena da na Monza Gustavo Varela.

results.title: Me ya sa magoya bayan Man City ke yi wa taken Premier League ihu?
results.content: Hayaniyar ihu da tsangwama lokacin taken Premier League da Champions League kafin fara wasa yanzu ya zama ruwan dare a filin wasa na Etihad Stadium.

results.title: Muhimman abubuwa 5 da Tinubu da muƙarrabansa suka faɗa a Kaduna
results.content: Wani abu da ya ja hankali a game da taron shi ne yadda Tinubu ya ƙaddamar da wani ɓangare na aikin titin Abuja zuwa Kaduna zuwa Kano a filin taron.

results.title: Abu 5 da ya kamata ku sani kan fara yaƙin neman zaɓen Tinubu a Kaduna
results.content: Yayin da Najeriya ke shirin gudanar da babban zaben shekarar 2027, jam'iyyar APC ta shirya fara yakin neman zaben sake zaben Shugaba Bola Ahmed Tinubu a ranar 24 ga Oktoba, 2026, a Jihar Kaduna.

results.title: Zaɓen 2027: Jihohi 7 da Atiku Abubakar zai fuskanci ƙalubale
results.content: Sadai dai ana ganin dukkan ƴan takarar akwai jihohi da sassan ƙasar da za su yi tasiri, sannan akwai jihohi da sassan da ake ganin za su fuskanci ƙalubale wajen tara ƙuri'u.

results.title: Yadda wata cutar shanu ta yi sanadin mutuwar mutum a karon farko a duniya
results.content: Shav cuta ce da ta fi shafar shanu, wadda ake iya yaɗa ta ta hanyar ƙananan ƙwari masu shan jini da aka sani da midges.

results.title: Me ya sa har yanzu Houthi ke samun nasara wajen kai wa Saudiyya hari?
results.content: Duk da cewa Saudiyya na daga cikin ƙasashen da suka fi kashe kuɗi wajen tsaro a duniya, Houthi sun ci gaba da nuna cewa suna da damar kai hare-hare ta amfani da makamai masu linzami da jirage marasa matuƙa.

results.title: Aston Villa na nazari kan Garnacho, Brighton na hari Diego Gomez
results.content: Aston Villa na shakkun ɗaukar Alejandro Garnacho a maimakon ɗan ci gaba da taka mata leda a matsayin ɗan wasan aro, Brighton ta dage kan ba zata siyar da Diego Gomez ba, sai Manchester United da masu neman shugabancin ƙungiyar ke bayana damuwa kan yan wasan ƙungiyar.

results.title: Matakai 6 da gwamnatin Tinubu za ta ɗauka don rage raɗaɗi na kwana 90

results.title: Mene ne harajin man fetur da Tinubu ke son ɓullo da shi?
results.content: Wata sabuwar muhawara ta kunno kai a Najeriya kan zargin cewa gwamnatin ƙasar na shirin ɓullo da wani sabon haraji da ka iya ƙara tasiri ga farashin man fetur a ƙasar.

results.title: Wace ce matar da ta kai Ebola Najeriya?
results.content: Matar wani jami'in diflomasiyya ne da ke Abuja ta yi tafiya zuwa Kampala don hutu.

results.title: Yaya girman rikicin cikin-gida a APC, kuma ta yaya zai shafi jam'iyyar?
results.content: Ana dai ganin akwai wasu alamun ɓaraka a babbar jam'iyyar ta APC a cikin-gida, kamar yadda lamarin yake a sauran jam'iyyu a ƙasar, musamman waɗanda suke da ƙarfi a siyasar ƙasar.

results.title: Wace ƙungiya ce Como wadda ta koya wa Man United darasi?
results.content: Labarin nasarar Serie A Como ta koma daga Serie D zuwa Gasar Zakarun Turai - yanzu sun koya wa Manchester United darasi a Turai.
